what: Painted ball — a six-stop palette made from the skin accent color (deep night-brown → accent → apricot → near white) forms a value-noise sheet, viewed through a spherical lens and bent with domain-warped noise so the paint flows slowly along the grain (time .12/sec). An accent-colored rim at the edge, cool shade on the far side, fine grain. Press the ball and ripple rings spread from the pressed spot along the ball surface (1.6s, up to three overlapping). Press a tab child or send fx:goto and the ball rolls to another spot on the picture (exponential .35s) while the paint is twisted and stirred toward the center (rise .12s · settle .7s)

options.frames: Number of slots to roll (tab count), default 3
options.speed: Paint flow speed (time/sec), default .12 — 0 stops it
options.[data-fx-part=ball]: Spot to draw the ball (child, square) — the element itself if none
options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Picker buttons (children) — click to roll to that numbered slot, with aria-pressed
options.fx:goto: Scrolls to that spot when sent to the element (detail.index)

note: three r182. The ball doesn’t follow the cursor (the original only reacts to press·tap). Shaders are precompiled on setup. With reduced motion it doesn’t flow and a tap switches immediately in place
